The person on the left, wearing a camouflage-patterned shirt, holds a green tennis racket with a white handle. The individual on the right, dressed in a dark t-shirt and shorts, is positioned slightly behind and to the side of the first person. The background features parked cars, a building with large windows, and some greenery, suggesting a suburban setting.

This substance appears to be splashing outwards, creating a dynamic visual effect. The person on the right seems to be reacting to the unexpected release, possibly stepping back or preparing to dodge. The scene captures a moment of surprise and action, with the red substance adding a vivid contrast to the otherwise neutral tones of the environment

caption:
In an outdoor paved courtyard lit by daylight, a person's arm in a camouflage sleeve grips the white handle of a lime-green racket held horizontally, its strings facing the camera, while a compact red mass sits on the right side of the strings. Behind it, a man in a red cap, a dark t-shirt with yellow lettering, grey shorts and grey shoes stands facing forward with his hands clasped, holding the same pose throughout. Parked cars, a green building with an arch, trees and a brick building with arched windows fill the background.

The hand, racket and background stay essentially fixed, with no camera pan or zoom, so the dominant visible change is the red mass on the stationary strings. It already occupies a small rounded blob on the right side and, over the clip, progressively enlarges and deforms into a larger, irregular, frayed clump. Thin spiky tendrils radiate outward from the mass, and its overall footprint increases rather than sliding across the strings, eventually extending beyond the right rim of the green frame. The expansion is still ongoing as the excerpt ends.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
